response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS mix, s.instownpct AS own FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), base AS (SELECT mix, AVG(own) AS mix_avg FROM units GROUP BY mix), overall AS (SELECT AVG(own) AS overall_avg FROM units), kept AS (SELECT u.own, b.mix_avg, o.overall_avg FROM units u JOIN base b ON u.mix = b.mix CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE u.own > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(own) AS avg_kept_ownership, AVG(own / mix_avg) AS avg_ownership_to_baseline_ratio, AVG(own - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Units with NULL instownpct are excluded before computing the mix baselines and the overall average (missing values ignored, so they do not form units).
The overall average is the average of unit ownerships (one per snapshot), not weighted by transaction.
A mix baseline of 0 would make the ratio NULL or error; this is treated as not occurring in practice, since kept units have ownership above the overall average.
